title: Binarization as an Attack Surface in Weightless Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.17646v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weightless Neural Networks (WNNs) are lightweight classifiers that binarize their inputs and learn by storing binary patterns in lookup memories, which makes them attractive for resource-constrained tasks such as intrusion detection. Because a small perturbation that crosses no binarization threshold leaves the binary input unchanged, WNNs may appear naturally robust to adversarial examples; a perturbation that does cross a threshold, however, can still change the prediction. We study this tension in WiSARD, the canonical RAM-based WNN, and in two variants that replace its memories with Bloom filters, Bloom WiSARD and BTHOWeN. A continuous perturbation reaches these classifiers only by crossing an encoding threshold, changing at least one binary tuple, and redirecting a memory query; we formalize this mechanism with a threshold-crossing bound and a response-margin certificate for standard Boolean WiSARD. translated_title: 二值化：无权重神经网络的攻击面
translated_abstract: 无权重神经网络（WNNs）是一类轻量级分类器，它们对输入进行二值化处理，并通过在查找存储器中存储二进制模式来进行学习，这使其在入侵检测等资源受限任务中颇具吸引力。由于不跨越任何二值化阈值的微小扰动不会改变二进制输入，无权重神经网络似乎对对抗样本具有天然的鲁棒性；然而，一旦扰动跨越了阈值，仍可能改变模型的预测结果。我们在WiSARD（经典的基于RAM的无权重神经网络）以及两个用布隆过滤器替代其存储器的变体——Bloom WiSARD和BTHOWeN——中研究了这一矛盾。连续扰动只有通过跨越编码阈值、改变至少一个二进制元组并重定向存储器查询，才能影响这些分类器；我们通过阈值跨越界限和标准布尔WiSARD的响应边际证书对这一机制进行了形式化。受控MNIST实验…
tldr: 该研究揭示了无权重神经网络（WiSARD及其布隆过滤器变体）虽然看似对对抗样本天然鲁棒，但其二值化阈值本身可被利用为攻击面，并通过阈值跨越界限和响应边际证书对这一攻击机制进行了形式化证明。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that while Weightless Neural Networks like WiSARD and its Bloom filter variants appear naturally robust to adversarial examples, their binarization thresholds can serve as an attack surface, formalized through a threshold-crossing bound and a response-margin certificate.
